entities.summary: Abū ʿAmr ʿĀmir ibn Sharāḥīl ibn ʿAbd al-Kūfī al-Shaʿbī, 641–723, commonly known as Imam al-Sha'bi or al-Sha'bi, was an Arab historian and jurist of the tabi'un, born during the rule of Umar ibn al-Khattab.
